name: Work Board
tagline: A board of lists and cards for your workspaces and agents, kept on this Mac.

sections.heading: Your work as cards
sections.body: The Board is a Trello-like board with a tab of its own (Cmd+1). A card follows a workspace, an agent session or something you add yourself, and carries its pull requests, links, files, checklist and notes.
bullets: Cards move to In Progress, Review and Done from agent activity, pull requests and the reports your Claude and Codex sessions end their replies with
Links and Files on each card; sessions add the links and files their task uses
Drag cards and lists; drop a card in the Trash to remove it, with Undo. Removed cards stay 30 days, then are deleted
Board data is stored on your Mac

sections.heading: Board AI
sections.body: An optional chat that keeps the Board true. It runs through your own Claude Code or Codex sign-in and stays paused until you choose an account.
bullets: Ask it to move cards, message your agent sessions or start a session for a card; each can be turned off in settings
Memory: one plain file of your preferences and corrections, which you can read, edit, clear or turn off
Slash commands such as /new session, /new card, /memory and /clear
